dynamic_line.gendered_line: It takes only a moment to retrieve a suitable coin from your pockets, and yet your interlocutor found enough time to disappear, having left a sharp emptiness both in memory and the chair before you.  The anchor has been neatly folded on the table.

responses.text: Take the anchor and leave the coin.  Do we have a deal?
Just leave, this isn't right at all.
